caption:
A few weeks back at the desk and Mr Turtle's upper back feels like a brick wall.

Your upper back is built to bend, arch, rotate and side-bend, but desk days mostly ask for one direction. Pilates works through all of them in a controlled way, which is often why a stiff upper back enjoys it.

Start simple: five wide rib breaths on your back, a few small chest lifts face down, then eight slow open books each side. Smooth, not forced.

Chest pain or breathlessness needs prompt medical care. Pain after a fall or pain that wakes you is worth an assessment. Our Pilates team at Hybrid Physio can build a mat and reformer program around your back. Book online via the link in bio 🐢

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
